body:
GitHub issue #778.

PROBLEM
packages/spec-lint/lib/report.mjs buildHumanReport prints `WARNING: no criteria found in spec.` when classified.length === 0, contradicting the exit-2 hard gate failure introduced in #494.

BUILD
1. In packages/spec-lint/lib/report.mjs buildHumanReport, replace the stale `WARNING: no criteria found in spec.` line with `FAIL: no acceptance criteria found in spec.`.
2. Add unit and CLI assertions in packages/spec-lint/test/spec-lint.test.mjs verifying buildHumanReport and CLI stdout on a zero-criteria spec.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- AC1: buildHumanReport([], "spec.md") emits `FAIL: no acceptance criteria found in spec.` and never `WARNING: no criteria found`. verify: `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/spec-lint.test.mjs`
- AC2: All spec-lint tests pass. verify: `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/*.test.mjs`
title: spec-lint: report FAIL instead of WARNING on zero-criteria human report (#778)
